title: Enanta Pharmaceuticals Announces First Patient Dosed in the RESOLVE Phase 2b/3 Study of Zelicapavir, a Potential First-in-Disease Treatment for Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV)
summary: WATERTOWN, Mass., October 26, 2026--Enanta Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:ENTA), a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to creating small molecule drugs for viral infections and immunological diseases, today announced that the first patient has been dosed in RESOLVE, its global Phase 2b/3 clinical trial of zelicapavir in adults at high risk of severe outcomes from RSV infection. Topline data from the Phase 2b portion of the study are expected in 2027.
